verdict.rationale: Cactus's Needle README documents that the same model returns a sentence vector so an app can search, match and route locally. That is a first-party embedding capability for retrieval-style use, but it rests on one brief mention. Missing for 10: support for dedicated or third-party embedding models, a documented embedding API endpoint or serving interface, retrieval and search quality or benchmark evidence, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can serve embedding models for retrieval and search applications

citations.quote: the same model returns a vector for a sentence, so an app can search, match and route locally.
